name: duckling_crest_puff
rationale: Plan phase 0: friendly duckling theme — a soft rounded crest tuft suggesting a hatchling's feather puff, matching the XGO Duck's rounded head shell seen in the renders. Compact base ellipse (~14x12x2.5 mm) stays well inside the 80x80x35 mm zone and light mass budget. Three tilted-back ellipsoid puffs (center plus bilateral pair) overlap the base positively; all rotated shapes keep lowest Z above 0 given centers >= ~3 mm with half-extents < ~3 mm. No fins or boxes, so no sharp or intimidating silhouettes. Camera lens on the front face and all source geometry untouched; attachment remains an unverified adhesive-pad proposal on the source triangle tangent.
